name: Recent orders
description: The last three orders with their status and total; tap to track.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/recent-orders", name: "Recent orders", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The last three orders with their status and total; tap to track.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Recent orders", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      ForEach(items: options.orders, as: "o", limit: 3, empty: Text(child: "No orders yet.", color: Color.textMuted), child: Box(padding: Space.md, radius: Radius.md, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), onTap: Navigate(to: Route.order(id: o.id)), ariaLabel: "Order ${o.order_number}", child: Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
        Expanded(child: Column(gap: Space.xs, children: [Text(child: "Order ${o.order_number}", weight: FontWeight.semibold), Text(child: o.store_name, size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted)])),
        Badge(label: o.status, tone: Tone.primary),
        Text(child: formatMoney(o.total_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold)
      ])))
    ])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "orders", type: Order, list: true, required: true)],
)
